text:
TAQESİM AL-YAWN AL-'AAMM
Tatmalaquna al-yawm taqaatun ‘azīmatun wa nashātun dākhiliyyun farīd, ya‘muru qalbaka bi-l-tafā’ul wa-l-ishrāq. Yajlibu laka hādhā al-yawm afkāran mubtakaratan wa ru’yatan jadīdatan tusa‘iduka ‘alā tajāwuzi al-šu‘ūr bi-l-malal al-ladhī qad yatasarralu ilā rūḥika fī al-fatrat al-akhīrah. Ruhuka al-mughtanimah wa dhihnuka al-mutawaqqid sayaj‘alānihiyya al-yawm munasiban jiddan li-l-tawasul ma‘a al-akharīn wa istikshāf afāq jadīdah. Kūn musta‘iddan li-istiqbāl al-mufāja’āt al-jamīlah allatīy qad tughayyiru majrā yawmika ilā al-afḍal.

AL-‘ISQ WA AL-‘ALAQĀT
Idhā kunta murtabitan, fa-hādhā al-yawm huwa al-waqt al-mithālī li-tajdīd al-shgharrah ma‘a shurīki ḥayātika ‘abr ḥadīthin ‘amīqin wa mushārakati lahazātin mulli’at bi-l-daḥk wa-l-maraf. Inna kalimātika al-latihifatu sayakūnu lahā atharun siḥriyyun ‘alā taqwiyat al-rawābith al-‘āṭifiyyah wa izālat ayyi su’ fahmin sābiq. Ammā bi-nisbati li-l-‘udhāb, fa-qad yushīru al-falak ilā liqā’in ghayr mutawaqqa‘in yushe‘ilu sharārat al-i‘jāb fī qalbika, fa-kūn mutafā’ilan wa la tutaraddad fī iẓhār shakhsiyyatika al-jadhdhābah wa-l-mرحah.

AL-‘AMAL WA AL-KARIYAR
Tatamayyazu al-yawm bi-qudratin fā’iqatin ‘alā idārat al-mahāmm al-muta‘addidah bi-kafā’atin ‘āliyah, wahādhā mā sayaj‘aluka maḥaṭṭa anzār ru’asā’ika fī al-‘amal. Innahā fursatun dhahabiyyun li-ṭarḥi afkārika al-ibdā‘iyyah wa taqdīm hulūlin ghayr taqlīdiyyah li-ba‘ḍi al-masā’il al-‘āliqah. Ursuqu al-dahna wa kun marinan fī al-ta‘āmul ma‘a al-zumalā’, fa-innamā ta‘āwunukum sayuqaddimu lakum najāḥan mushtarkan yaftahu amāmakum abwāban jadīdan lil-tarqiyah aw al-tatawwur al-mihni.

AL-MĀ’ WA AL-BARAKAH
Al-waḍ‘ al-māliyy yashhadu istiqrāran malhūẓan, ma‘a imkāniyyati ḥuṣūlika ‘alā fursa maliyyatin ghayr muntaẓarah tarji‘u ‘alayka bi-n-naf‘. Raġma hādhā, yunsaḥu bi-l-ta‘ammul bi-hikmatin ma‘a al-mashrū‘āt al-tijāriyyah al-jadīdah wa ‘adam al-ta‘jīl fī al-infāq ‘alā al-kamāliyyāt ghayr al-ḍarūriyyah. Inna takhtīṭaka al-dhakī li-l-mustaqbal al-māliyy sayaj‘aluka tash‘uru bi-l-amān wa al-istiqrār al-nafsī fī hādhā al-yawm al-mumayyiz.

AL-SIḤḤAH WA AL-ṬĀQAH
Bidanuk wa ‘aqluka fī hālati inshirāḥin wadih, lakinni anshughāruka al-mustamirru qad yasribu min taqātika idhā lam taḥtawi nafsaka bi-l-rāḥah al-kāfiylah. Yumkinuka istikhdāmu al-riyyāḍah al-khafīfah aw al-mashy fī al-hawā’ al-ṭalq li-tafrīghi al-shahnāt al-salbiyyah wa tajdīdu al-nashāt. Ihtimāmuka bi-tanāwuli al-aghdhiyah al-sihhiyyah wa shurb al-kammiyyat al-kāfiyah min al-mā’ sayad‘amu manā‘ataka wa yumadduka bi-l-hayawiyyah طuwāla al-yawm.

AL-TAWASUL WA AL-BĪ’AH AL-IJTIMĀ‘IYYAH
Al-ajwā’ al-‘ā’iliyyah mili’atun bi-l-daff’ wa al-tahāmun al-mutabādal, wa qad tajidu da‘man kabīran min muḥīṭika al-qurayb li-mushāri‘ika al-shakhsiyyah. Inna liqā’an mashriqan ma‘a al-asdiqa’ al-qudamā’ sayajlibu ilā qalbika al-sa‘ādah wa yusā‘iduka ‘alā istijmā‘i dhikrayātin jamīlah. Kūn musta‘iddan li-samā‘i nasīhatin qaimatin min shakhshin muqarrabin, fa-inna kalimātuhu qad tunīru laka ṭarīqan lam takun tatawaqqanuhu.

NAṢĪHAT AL-YAWM
"Da‘ al-marunata taqudu khutwātika; fa-l-hayātu lā tastajību lil-quwwah, bal tastajību lil-tawaffuq ma‘a tiyārihā bi-ḥikmatin wa dhakā’."

TAFĀSĪL AL-YAWM
Al-raqam al-maẓhūẓ: 3
Al-lawn al-maẓhūẓ: Al-Aṣfar al-Sāti‘ (Bright Yellow)
Al-burj al-mutawāfiq: Al-Mīzān (Libra)
